newsitem.title: UK: Shield down further on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Shield down further on profit-taking.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc tumbled on Monday as investors continued to take profits following sharp rises in the share price earlier in the year, dealers said.
The often-volatile stock dropped 37-1/2p to 490p by 1321 GMT, extending recent losses prompted in part by directors cashing in options.
"The selling is scrappy but the stock is very volatile," said one dealer, while others cited the lack of fresh postive news on the company's heart disease diagnostic test as being behind the selling.
"The lack of news flow has made investors twitchy," he said.
The shares have fallen back since reaching a record of 928p on March 14, over six times its value at the end of January.
